Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts, Step 4):
1. The source keeps the variant parameter `warehouse_loss_claim_window_days` with the schema description "Calendar days after a lost or damaged-in-warehouse adjustment within which the seller may claim a reimbursement not issued automatically", while the clause using it is retired by `overwrite`. The KB renders it as a row of "Reimbursement Claim Periods by FBN Program" (with the generic note "a window is the number of days within which it may be filed") and reconciles it in reimbursement_terms ("withdrawn … The program figures … remain the figures of each program"). The reconciliation is explicit, so the KB carries the source faithfully; the residue originates in the source's parameter description.
2. Base clause "A lost_in_warehouse … adjustment not found within the auto-reimburse days is reimbursed automatically" is in force, while this world holds lost-in-warehouse adjustments older than 30 days with no reimbursement row (e.g. 2026-05-27, 2026-07-09, 2026-08-04). The claimable-lost-units rule deducts only reimbursement rows on record, so the solution stays unique; noted as a world/base-rule tension of the policy side, not a document defect.
